name: Statistics
description: Statistics programmes teach how to reason from data that is incomplete, noisy and imperfectly collected — study design, estimation, inference, regression, and the judgement about when a number means anything at all. It is the discipline the newer data programmes are built on top of.
degreesNote: A Bachelor of Science in Statistics, with master’s and doctoral degrees above it, at six Florida public institutions — every one of them awarding the bachelor’s. ⚠ At several schools it sits inside the mathematics department rather than standing alone, so look for a statistics TRACK as well as a named degree. There is no licence in this field.

cips.note: Statistics — six Florida public institutions, all awarding a bachelor’s and several through to the doctorate.

related.note: The newer programme built on the same foundation. ⚠ The honest difference: data science adds programming, machine learning and data engineering; statistics goes deeper into inference and study design, and travels further into research, biostatistics and government work.
The other half of most data work. A statistics degree plus real programming ability is a stronger combination than either alone, and it is what most job adverts are actually describing.
